mechanics.claim: The Spirit echoes a portion of pre-mitigation damage it takes to the tethered target as the ability's damage; this is the only source of damage from this ability in a dummy fight.
mechanics.quote: echoes a portion of the {{tt|pre-mitigation damage|Damage calculated before modifiers}} received to the tethered champion

mechanics.claim: Echoed damage type matches the damage type that hit the Spirit (physical/magic/true), not a fixed type.
Echoed damage is capped to the Spirit's current health, and modifiers apply in a specific (potentially inconsistent) order.
mechanics.quote: Echoed damage is calculated by taking the pre-mitigation damage against the {{as|Spirit|buzzword}}, applying ''Test of Spirit's'' damage modifier, and then capping it to the {{as|Spirit's|buzzword}} {{as|'''current''' health}}.

mechanics.claim: Transferred/echoed damage applies on-damage effects like damage amplifiers, Black Cleaver, Morellonomicon, etc., but does not doubly apply on-hit or on-spell effects to the Vessel.
mechanics.quote: Transferred damage will apply on-damage effects, such as damage amplifiers ... Transferred damage will not doubly apply on-hit or on-spell effects versus the target

mechanics.claim: Illaoi cannot recast Test of Spirit until the current Spirit dies.
mechanics.quote: Test of Spirit cannot be cast again until the {{as|Spirit|buzzword}} dies.

mechanics.claim: Ability is unusable/locked out while the projectile travels and while pulling the Spirit.
mechanics.quote: '''Illaoi''' is {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} while firing the projectile and while the target's {{as|Spirit|buzzword}} is being pulled.
